title: Satwik-Chirag Storm Into Third China Masters Final
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, are on the verge of winning their second title of the year.
summary: India's star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, defeated their Malaysian rivals in three games to reach their third China Masters final, aiming for a second title this year.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course offers advanced training for badminton coaches at National Centers of Excellence in India, crucial for developing future Indian talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: India's promising young shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing young talent.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations have been released for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, a key domestic tournament for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for the upcoming domestic event.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships will impact the development of young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
